ln:4463808621.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 59158

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build and operate pipelines for structured domain data (onboarding events, customer/entity data, credit facilities/exposures, limits, risk grades, portfolio hierarchies, performance and arrears).
  • Build unstructured data pipelines for domain documents (KYC documents, corporate registries extracts, credit memos, financial statements, portfolio review materials): parsing, metadata enrichment, deduplication and retention handling.
  • Develop embedding/vectorisation pipelines and manage vector indices with refresh and deletion strategies aligned to data governance.
  • Implement data quality, observability and lineage: automated testing, SLAs, anomaly detection, monitoring and runbooks.
  • Apply privacy-by-design: PII handling, masking/tokenisation where required, access controls and audit trails.
  • Implement dataset versioning and reproducibility (snapshots, schema evolution, data contracts) to support repeatable evaluations.
  • Partner with Agent Engineers and stakeholders to define data requirements and evaluation datasets; close feedback loops from production retrieval/agent performance.
  • Support production operations and continuous improvement of data services powering AI.

Requirements

  • Delivering reliable, fresh, well-governed datasets and indices used by KYC, credit and portfolio AI solutions.
  • Improving retrieval relevance and answer grounding by strengthening metadata, chunking inputs, and data quality.
  • Reducing operational incidents through strong testing, monitoring, and disciplined change management.
  • Making AI datasets reproducible and auditable to support reviews and control expectations.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People & Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 10+ years’ experience in Strong software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design, Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Job Summary

As an Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing delivery of high-quality, innovative products and solutions. Your role will involve strategic planning, technical leadership, and ensuring that projects are completed on time and within budget. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and operations, to drive the development of scalable and reliable systems.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Align technical solutions with strategic organisational goals and long-term vision.
  • Lead and implement detailed technical solutions for complex, organization-wide projects including end-to-end holistic solution design (interfacing systems).
  • Develop and drive technology strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the Subdomain Tech Lead.
  • Provide high-level analysis for planning, and initiatives implementation approaches.
  • Expert in solution sizing, estimation, and project forecasting
  • Support audit reviews and exercises.
  • Drive RFP and vendor evaluation exercise along with PO to ensure SCB technical standards are met

Business

  • Act as a senior escalation point for technical issues.
  • Promote engineering craftsmanship and drive strategic business value.
  • Collaborate with PO and align technical solutions to support prioritized backlogs to deliver value driven capabilities.
  • Oversee technical delivery and excellence across multiple squads or hives.
  • Influence prioritization for technology backlog and strategic initiatives.
  • Knowledge on Wealth domain and technology would be added advantage. (knowledge on MS Dynamic is preferred).

Processes

  • Improve engineering processes to drive efficiency and collaboration.
  • Analyse and mitigate dependencies to enable quality and speed of delivery.
  • Drive solution standardization and service reusability.
  • Define frameworks and standards for product.
  • Actively contribute to process improvement and innovation
  • Collaborate with IT Change and Release Managers to develop strategic delivery and release plans with technical dependencies.
  • Ensure high-level technical consistency of solution with business and enterprise technology standards.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence within squads.

People & Talent

  • Able to work with cross functional team.
  • Able to influence technical adoption by squad teams

Risk Management

  • Mitigate technical risks and ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with application security and regulatory standards.
  • Manage technical risks throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Support required solution to achieve ERR Treatment plan
  • Proactively identify and address potential risks.
  • Ensure compliance with bank compliance guidelines & standards (e.g. data protection)

Governance

  • Ensure product and solution development is aligned with enterprise architecture and standards.
  • Maintain consistency in technical practices across squads.
  • Lead governance of application/platform-specific technical standards.
  • Address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Represent sub domain in relevant architecture forum and drive vendor solutions in accordance with organizational standards.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Domain Tech Lead
  • Chief Product Owner / Product Owners
  • Architecture Team
  • Release Managers

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Wealth Journey squad;
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

Skills And Experience

Application Delivery Process

  • Proven experience in managing and delivering complex technical projects in an enterprise environment.
  • Ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring quality and timely delivery.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience with Agile and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies.
  • Capability to coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Specific examples of past project management successes, demonstrating effective leadership and delivery.

Technical Skills

  • Strong engineering background with extensive experience in delivering high-quality technical solutions in an enterprise environment.
  • Ability to interact with APIs, databases, and other technical components.
  • Proficiency in understanding code and its implications on the system, enabling effective technical conversations and decision-making.
  • Knowledge of modern software development practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

Problem Solving

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills honed through years of practical experience in the field.
  • Ability to think critically and make sound technical decisions under pressure.
  • Experience in identifying, diagnosing, and addressing complex technical problems.
  • Capability to balance short-term fixes with long-term solutions, leveraging past experiences to guide decisions.

Technical Aptitude

  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and best practices in architecture.
  • Ability to design scalable, reliable, and secure solutions based on extensive industry experience.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, version control systems).
  • Experience in setting up and maintaining engineering practices to high standards, with tangible examples from previous roles.
  • Ability to drive technical conversations and provide mentorship based on a wealth of practical experience.

Others

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, crucial for effective interaction in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Effective stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience in documenting technical designs and solutions for a range of audiences.
  • Ability to articulate complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Certifications: Relevant certifications in software development, project management, or Agile methodologies (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, PMP, Certified ScrumMaster)

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4451677260.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Experienced Technology Delivery professional who manages the successful technical delivery of products. A skilled technology expert who works across multiple squads or hives for delivery of complex Features, Epics & Releases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver solution intent and application designs, produce clear and comprehensive design and solution intent documents.
  • Support business in appropriate sequencing of the backlog, refinement, and rationalization through a technical lens.
  • Oversee the implementation of microservices architecture where applicable
  • Design APIs and ensure they are secure, scalable, and well-documented according to standards
  • Manage and mitigate technical risks in the delivery.
  • Present Solutions to the architecture review forum.
  • Architecture Review Forum: 4 statements that requires PO's attestation (part of LuW)
  • In submitting this initiative for approval at the QPR, I attest that I have started or completed these requirements
  • Where I have started but not completed these requirements, this is in accordance with the requirements from the risk group
  • Where I have not started, I have received dispensation from the respective risk group(s) to proceed without fulfilling the requirements, in part or in full
  • Where I have not received dispensation, I have received approval from the QPR Coordinator to submit this initiative into the proposed backlog for approval"
  • Align with technology architects on the target solution design to minimize technical debt.
  • Align technical solutions and the applications with established security control requirements, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation to avoid potential penalties
  • Collaborate with Security Champions to identify and implement the necessary security controls tailored to the specific delivery or process. Identify Applicable Security controls by engaging with Security Champs
  • Review and approve the chapter 1 & 2 of the Solution Intent within the eSDLC framework before it proceeds to Domain or Country Architect approval.
  • Technology Governance
  • Comply with System Delivery controls and attest for it with every (technical) release to production
  • The controls cover: Requirements, Architecture (see Architecture Review Forum below), Security (see Cyber Security Services below), Development, Testing, IT Resilience, Service Level Management, Tech Operations & Support, Release Management, SW Configuration Management
  • Complete comprehensive security impact assessments to ensure compliance with governance requirements and mitigate potential risks.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.

  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory

Qualifications - External

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Software Engineer.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Job ID:56148

Principal Responsibilities

  • Deliver AEM-related front-end development and componentisation (page/template/component development, front-end engineering practices, performance optimisation and maintainability improvements).
  • Design and develop Spring Boot microservices, including REST API design, business logic implementation, exception handling, logging and observability integration.
  • Participate in application deployment and runtime optimisation on AWS and Kubernetes (containerisation, configuration management, environment handling, capacity and performance tuning).
  • Collaborate with Product, Business, Architecture, QA, Operations/SRE and Security to drive requirement clarification, technical solution reviews and delivery execution.
  • Write and maintain database scripts, data-fix scripts and automation scripts to support releases and rapid production troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to code reviews, unit testing and CI practices to improve engineering quality and delivery efficiency.
  • Respond quickly to production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and drive long-term fixes and preventive actions.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software development experience with strong end-to-end delivery capability and solid engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on AEM front-end development experience with a good understanding of AEM component-based development and front-end best practices; able to deliver pages/components independently and optimise them.
  • Spring Boot microservices development experience; familiar with common microservices patterns, API design, and foundational capabilities such as authentication/authorisation, exception handling and logging.
  • Solid cloud-native fundamentals: working knowledge of core AWS services and architecture concepts; basic Kubernetes capability (deployment, service discovery, configuration and troubleshooting).
  • Strong database skills: proficient in relational databases (e.g., MySQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL) with data modelling and SQL; able to write release/rollback/data-fix scripts.
  • Scripting capability (Shell/Python, etc.) to support automation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: able to articulate technical solutions and risks clearly, and work effectively across teams to drive closure.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: able to diagnose issues under pressure, propose actionable solutions, and drive continuous improvement through post-incident reviews.

/WX/51

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Job Summary

Support the growth and operationalisation of the Insights Design Centre of Excellence (COE) by driving design governance, portfolio management, delivery coordination, and quality assurance across analytics and digital products.

Key Responsibilities

  • The role is responsible for establishing scalable operating practices, ensuring adherence to design standards, managing stakeholder engagement, and enabling consistent, high-quality user experiences across all analytics deliverables. Working closely with design, analytics, business, and technology teams, the role will help industrialise the end-to-end delivery lifecycle and strengthen the design maturity and delivery effectiveness.

Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the Insights Design COE strategy, operating model, and roadmap.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise design standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across analytics and digital products.
  • Identify opportunities to improve design efficiency, scalability, and consistency through standardisation, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance user experience, storytelling effectiveness, and delivery outcomes.
  • Support the evolution of design governance frameworks to align with organisational priorities and future-state delivery models.

Business

  • Partner with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and product owners to understand priorities, demand pipelines, and delivery requirements.
  • Manage intake, prioritisation, and tracking of design engagements across the portfolio.
  • Coordinate delivery activities to ensure timely execution of design initiatives and alignment with business objectives.
  • Develop management reporting and portfolio insights to provide visibility on delivery performance, quality metrics, resource utilisation, and business impact.
  • Support stakeholder engagement and communication throughout the design and delivery lifecycle.

Processes

  • Establish and manage design governance processes, review cycles, and quality checkpoints across analytics products.
  • Maintain and continuously improve design operating procedures, standards, templates, and delivery methodologies.
  • Facilitate design review sessions, stakeholder workshops, and project governance forums.

Monitor project progress, dependencies, risks, and issues to ensure effective execution and delivery.

  • Drive consistency in user experience, visual design, storytelling, and information architecture across all outputs.
  • Support adoption and management of design systems, component libraries, and reusable assets.

People & Talent

  • Promote a culture of design excellence, continuous learning, and quality-driven delivery.

Coach and guide analysts, designers, and project teams on design standards, storytelling principles, and best practices.

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and capability-building initiatives across the organisation.
  • Foster strong collaboration between business, analytics, technology, and design teams.
  • Support onboarding and enablement activities for new team members and contributors to the Insights Design COE.

Risk Management

  • Identify and proactively manage delivery, quality, and operational risks associated with design and analytics initiatives.
  • Ensure appropriate controls are embedded within design review and approval processes.
  • Escalate material risks, issues, and dependencies in a timely manner and support mitigation planning.
  • Monitor adherence to agreed standards and quality requirements to minimise rework and delivery delays.
  • Support compliance with organisational policies, accessibility requirements, and user experience standards where applicable.

Governance

  • Serve as a central governance function for the Insights Design COE, ensuring compliance with established design standards and frameworks.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews across dashboards, management reports, presentations, and analytics products.
  • Maintain governance artefacts, design repositories, standards documentation, and audit trails.
  • Track and report on quality metrics, review outcomes, adoption of standards, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure all deliverables meet agreed experience, design, storytelling, and usability standards prior to release.
  • Support governance forums and leadership reporting to drive accountability and continuous enhancement of delivery quality.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Financial Crime Prevention; The Right Environment.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Governance & Control
  • UX Design / Design Thinking
  • Standards & Scaling Capability

Other Skills

  • Manage Stakeholders
  • Portfolio & Demand Management
  • Quality Assurance
  • AI & Innovation mindset

Motivations

  • Passionate about designing intuitive, user-centered experiences that simplify complex business processes and create measurable business value.
  • Energized by establishing design standards, governance, and best practices that improve consistency, quality, and adoption across a portfolio of analytics and digital products.
  • Motivated by influencing stakeholders, shaping strategic direction, and building a strong design culture that elevates user experience and insights excellence at scale.

Qualifications

  • Key Experiences: UIUX experience design ; Governance and controls
  • Language: English

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary
Support the growth and operationalisation of the Insights Design Centre of Excellence (COE) by driving design governance, portfolio management, delivery coordination, and quality assurance across analytics and digital products.
Key Responsibilities
- The role is responsible for establishing scalable operating practices, ensuring adherence to design standards, managing stakeholder engagement, and enabling consistent, high-quality user experiences across all analytics deliverables. Working closely with design, analytics, business, and technology teams, the role will help industrialise the end-to-end delivery lifecycle and strengthen the design maturity and delivery effectiveness.
Strategy
- Support the development and execution of the Insights Design COE strategy, operating model, and roadmap.
- Drive adoption of enterprise design standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across analytics and digital products.
- Identify opportunities to improve design efficiency, scalability, and consistency through standardisation, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance user experience, storytelling effectiveness, and delivery outcomes.
- Support the evolution of design governance frameworks to align with organisational priorities and future-state delivery models.
Business
- Partner with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and product owners to understand priorities, demand pipelines, and delivery requirements.
- Manage intake, prioritisation, and tracking of design engagements across the portfolio.
- Coordinate delivery activities to ensure timely execution of design initiatives and alignment with business objectives.
- Develop management reporting and portfolio insights to provide visibility on delivery performance, quality metrics, resource utilisation, and business impact.
- Support stakeholder engagement and communication throughout the design and delivery lifecycle.
Processes
- Establish and manage design governance processes, review cycles, and quality checkpoints across analytics products.
- Maintain and continuously improve design operating procedures, standards, templates, and delivery methodologies.
- Facilitate design review sessions, stakeholder workshops, and project governance forums.
Monitor project progress, dependencies, risks, and issues to ensure effective execution and delivery.
- Drive consistency in user experience, visual design, storytelling, and information architecture across all outputs.
- Support adoption and management of design systems, component libraries, and reusable assets.
- Promote a culture of design excellence, continuous learning, and quality-driven delivery.
Coach and guide analysts, designers, and project teams on design standards, storytelling principles, and best practices.
- Facilitate knowledge sharing and capability-building initiatives across the organisation.
- Foster strong collaboration between business, analytics, technology, and design teams.
- Support onboarding and enablement activities for new team members and contributors to the Insights Design COE.
Risk Management
- Identify and proactively manage delivery, quality, and operational risks associated with design and analytics initiatives.
- Ensure appropriate controls are embedded within design review and approval processes.
- Escalate material risks, issues, and dependencies in a timely manner and support mitigation planning.
- Monitor adherence to agreed standards and quality requirements to minimise rework and delivery delays.
- Support compliance with organisational policies, accessibility requirements, and user experience standards where applicable.
Governance
- Serve as a central governance function for the Insights Design COE, ensuring compliance with established design standards and frameworks.
- Conduct quality assurance reviews across dashboards, management reports, presentations, and analytics products.
- Maintain governance artefacts, design repositories, standards documentation, and audit trails.
- Track and report on quality metrics, review outcomes, adoption of standards, and continuous improvement opportunities.
- Ensure all deliverables meet agreed experience, design, storytelling, and usability standards prior to release.
- Support governance forums and leadership reporting to drive accountability and continuous enhancement of delivery quality.
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
- Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
- Achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Financial Crime Prevention; The Right Environment.
- Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Skills And Experience
Must-have Skills
- Governance & Control
- UX Design / Design Thinking
- Standards & Scaling Capability
Other Skills
- Manage Stakeholders
- Portfolio & Demand Management
- Quality Assurance
- AI & Innovation mindset
Motivations
- Passionate about designing intuitive, user-centered experiences that simplify complex business processes and create measurable business value.
- Energized by establishing design standards, governance, and best practices that improve consistency, quality, and adoption across a portfolio of analytics and digital products.
- Motivated by influencing stakeholders, shaping strategic direction, and building a strong design culture that elevates user experience and insights excellence at scale.
Qualifications
- Key Experiences: UIUX experience design ; Governance and controls
- Language: English
Together We

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business:Group Functions Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain a robust Python-based orchestration service for coordinating workflows, applications and enterprise systems.
  • Build, deploy and operate scalable services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Develop reliable integrations with internal platforms, APIs, data services and enterprise applications.
  • Automate provisioning, deployment, testing and operational processes using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and performance optimisation to support service reliability and resilience.
  • Apply secure engineering practices, including access management, secrets protection, vulnerability remediation and compliance controls.
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents, conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventative improvements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Professional experience developing and maintaining production-grade services using Python.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and cloud-native services.
  • Practical experience deploying and operating workloads on Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Strong understanding of containerisation technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automation tools, such as Terraform.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control and automated testing practices.
  • Knowledge of service monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, security and operational resilience.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***
